investment_strategy: Constructive-but-cautious, AI-infrastructure–led core-satellite. With VIX near 23 and the 10Y at ~4.3%, favor quality balance sheets, recurring cloud/software cash flows, and diversified AI monetization while tightly sizing higher-volatility semiconductors. Overweight AI platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) as resilient core exposure; add focused AI compute capacity via NVIDIA and lithography leader ASML for upside; use IBM as a lower-beta enterprise AI ballast. Maintain modest semi weights due to export-control and cycle risks; rebalance quarterly or if position weights drift >5% from targets.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI platforms for resilient cash flows plus selective AI hardware leaders for upside; risk sized for elevated volatility and higher rates.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Screened for: positive analyst consensus (BUY/STRONG_BUY), strong fundamental growth, favorable momentum where possible, and relatively lower volatility within megacap tech. Weights reflect macro (VIX~23, 10Y~4.3%), quality balance sheets, diversified AI monetization, and news catalysts while capping high-beta semi exposure.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Near-term constructive but choppy. Expect continued leadership from AI infrastructure and platforms, supported by hyperscaler/data-center capex. Monitor regulatory/antitrust pressure on Big Tech and export controls affecting semis. Favor quality, cash-generative leaders; rebalance quarterly or on material guidance/regulatory changes.
